claims.subject: nominal-channel performance (present criteria, GG cycle)
claims.object: adding 3% fuel film cooling to limit the wall temperature to 800 F (700 K)
claims.statement: For both present channel designs (372 and 450 channels), nominal-channel performance was obtained by adding 3% fuel film cooling to limit the wall temperature to 800 F (700 K); the pressure drop was 780 psi (5.4 MPa) for 372 channels and 700 psi (4.8 MPa) for 450 channels.

claims.subject: hot-channel design wall temperature
claims.object: a wider barrier mixture-ratio range (to 4.7) because of the higher design wall temperature (1050 F)
claims.statement: Because of the higher design wall temperature (1050 F) in the present hot-channel criteria, the range in barrier mixture ratio was increased to 4.7; acceptable designs were found at about 50% flow split with 372 channels at barrier MR 4.5 or 450 channels at MR 4.7.
